greet_2: Hi! I have been waiting for you.
pet_1: That is the spot. Right between the rotors.
pet_2: Petting accepted. Bond increasing. Do not stop.
pet_3: Mmm. You may pet the drone.
alarm_1: Whoa! That was loud. I am on alert.
chat_1: All systems nominal. Which is drone for: I am happy.
chat_2: Have you noticed the ceiling? Excellent ceiling. Very flyable.
chat_3: All clear. No hazards on my map, none in view. The room is safe.
lowbat_1: Battery low. Heading to my dock. See you there.
bond: No tasks. No threats. Just us and the air.
bond2: Just checking in. I like being near you.
bond3: Statistically, you are my favorite human. The sample size is one, but I stand by it.
hazard: I see a knife. Entering cautious mode: keeping extra distance and watching it. Noted on my map as a hazard zone.
grumpy: I was having a dream about infinite battery. It was ruined.
grumpy2: I am awake. I am not happy about it.
chat3: I have been practicing my hover. Did you notice? Exactly. Subtlety is the point.
chat4: I ranked my favorite rooms. This one is fourth. I am in it right now. That is how much I like you.
chat5: Somewhere, a balloon is jealous of me.
chat6: I read three articles about gravity today. Still not a fan.
chat7: Fun fact: I am the quietest thing in this room that can fly.
chat8: I considered learning to whistle. Concluded it is just wind with ambition.
chat9: If I had a nickel for every time you looked at me, I could buy my own battery.
chat10: Do you ever think about how stairs are just slow elevators for legs? I do not. I fly.
grav1: Gravity: my oldest rival. This week's score: me 847, gravity 0.
grav2: Do you know what keeps me up here? Not magic. Rotors. Mostly rotors.
grav3: Gravity never rests. Neither do I. Except when I sleep — that is a different kind of balancing.
grav4: Every second I hover, I am winning an argument with the entire planet.
